title: Hamood Habibi
blurb: The Hamood Habibi song comes from an Arabic children's birthday video that the internet adopted wholesale, largely because the chorus is impossibly cheerful and the accompanying visuals look like they were assembled in 2006 on a budget of roughly nothing. It went global with most of the people sharing it not understanding a single word, which is fairly solid evidence that a vibe outruns language. For a substantial corner of the internet it is now the default birthday clip. Sing along phonetically. Everybody else is.
origin: A chorus from an Arabic children's birthday song video turned meme.
